    Datasets behind the cane toad records

    Source: R/data.R
    cane_toad_sources.Rd

    The GBIF datasets that published the records in cane_toad, with their title, publisher, licence, DOI and the number of records each contributed. Real metadata from the GBIF dataset and organisation APIs.

    Usage

    cane_toad_sources

    Format

    A tibble with 30 rows and 6 columns: dataset_key, title, publisher, licence, doi and n_records.

    Source

    GBIF registry API, https://api.gbif.org/v1/dataset/, accessed 27 November 2026.

    Examples

    cane_toad_sources
#> # A tibble: 30 × 6
#>    dataset_key                          title  publisher licence doi   n_records
